instructions:
## Objective

Train a LoRA adapter to solve eight families of symbolic puzzles using 1,000 supplied examples.

## Work to perform

Build local validation with the official greedy decoder and exact-answer metric. Standard PEFT artifacts are limited to rank 32, attention/MLP targets and 320 MiB; embedding/head changes and bias training are excluded.

## Deliverable

Two-file PEFT LoRA adapter.

## Evaluation

Choose the adapter with best public accuracy; report its private exact-answer accuracy normalized between the starter adapter and perfection.

This is a condensed paraphrase of Emulated’s public task page. Its Prompt tab contains the full agent-facing contract; package availability is separate from publication of that prompt.
